findings.summary: Minus signs on the recommended fund (-0.04%) and on the alternative (-1,030 ₪) look like losses and scare the reader off
Page opens with English letters and index jargon on the index buttons; feels not meant for the reader
Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even when enlarged
Recommended account and fund are unfamiliar firms while big banks are ranked lower
Cost bar colours are too similar to tell apart
The 7% return is only an example and the final 86,045 is not explained in plain words as an estimate
The 'בכסף של היום' / inflation button is unclear
Too many numbers per screen; dotted underlines with unknown meaning
Fund jargon in the fund box: קרן מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת, (4A)
